title: White Holes
description: The time-reverse of a black hole: a horizon nothing can enter.

puzzle.goal: Matter is thrown outward from a horizon that nothing can enter - the time-reverse of matter falling in from rest far away. Using the conserved energy E per unit rest mass (E = c for a particle at rest at infinity) and angular momentum L per unit mass, write the squared radial velocity (per unit proper time) as a function of r.
puzzle.name: Schwarzschild radial geodesic (white-hole ejection)
puzzle.ask: For radial motion (L = 0) with E = c the result is c·√(rs/r). Find the ejection speed at the radius below.

vars.E: conserved energy per unit rest mass, divided by c

puzzle.method: Combine the conserved energy and angular momentum with the four-velocity normalisation; solve for the radial rate.
